name: Digital Signature
description: Sign messages with SM2 / RSA / ECDSA / Ed25519 / Ed448, or verify with a public key.

hints.hash: SM2 always uses SM3, ECDSA always uses SHA-256, and Ed25519 / Ed448 are pure signatures — none of them accept a digest parameter.
hints.userId: The SM2 userId must match between signing and verification, otherwise verification fails.

faq.a: No. It is a business result: a modified message, a mismatched key or a different userId all cause it.

faq.q: Can openssl verify an SM2 signature?
faq.a: Yes, the output is ASN.1 DER and interoperates with OpenSSL.

faq.q: Should RSA use PSS or PKCS#1?
faq.a: PSS is the default. PKCS#1 v1.5 is available for legacy interoperability but is prone to padding-oracle attacks.
